description.value: Big Grin Bikes is a full-service bicycle shop in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, specializing in Scott bikes across all disciplines — road, gravel, mountain, and e-bikes — plus Benno eBikes and a wide range of apparel and accessories. In addition to in-shop service, they offer mobile mechanics, giving touring cyclists an option even if they can't make it to the store. The shop's mechanic, Lazarus, is described as focused on getting riders back on the road as quickly as possible.

address.value: 234 West 2nd Avenue, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1S8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record for address, phone, and business type. The service page explicitly states the mechanic will 'get you rolling as fast as possible' and they offer 'work in shop from tune ups to part upgrades,' confirming mechanical staff support and walk-in repairs. No explicit mention of a pump for visitors, bike rentals, DIY stand, washrooms, or most other amenities, so those are null. Two concerns flagged: OSM lists Monday as open but the contact page says Tuesday–Saturday only; and two different postal codes appear on the website (V9K 0A4 in the footer, V9K 1S8 on the contact page).
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Monday–Saturday, but the website contact page explicitly states Tuesday–Saturday only, with Sunday and Monday closed — OSM hours are likely outdated.
Two different postal codes appear on the website: V9K 0A4 in the site footer and V9K 1S8 on the contact page. The contact page value (V9K 1S8) is used here but should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active full-service bike shop on Vancouver Island with in-shop and mobile mechanic services; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical support or parts.
